OCR stays explicit opt-in. Local launcher prefers pinned Tesseract only when package and language checksums validate.
Existing journals retain historical identities; new backend options contribute to new job identities.
No API key or PDF sent externally; no release threshold changed.
retention_reason: Reuse five completed real-document OCR/index artifacts for the remaining retrieval and indexing-performance audit; do not rebuild them unnecessarily.
full_batch_note: Measured before the final progress-only remap at the persistence/index handoff; OCR, model, inputs and indexing algorithms are unchanged. Not a final performance SLO qualification.

next_bottleneck.next_action: Qualify GPU indexing on the same BGE model and data without changing quality thresholds; CPU remains the current default.

experiment.reproduction_source:
import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from campusai.retrieval.dense_index import DenseIndex,HASH_MODEL
original=DenseIndex.__init__
def gpu(self,items=None,model_name=HASH_MODEL,device="cpu",batch_size=8,model_revision="1"):
    original(self,items,model_name,"cuda",batch_size,model_revision)
DenseIndex.__init__=gpu
from scripts.operations.benchmark_pdf_uploads import main
main()
p=Path(".tmp/app-tesseract-cuda-20261025/full-batch.json")
r=json.loads(p.read_text())
files=list(Path(".tmp/app-tesseract-cuda-20261025/full-store/index").glob("*/dense.json"))
assert len(files)==5 and all(json.loads(f.read_text())["device"]=="cuda" for f in files)
r["experiment"]={"device_override":"cuda","production_source_device_changed":False,"gpu":torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),"peak_allocated_vram_bytes":torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated(),"reproduction_source":Path(__file__).read_text()}
p.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2),encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(r["experiment"] | {"reproduction_source":"retained in report"}),flush=True)
experiment.postprocessing_error: UnicodeDecodeError from default cp1252 after the benchmark finished and saved its report.
experiment.recovery: Read the five dense artifacts explicitly as UTF-8 and verify their persisted cuda device and unchanged corpus hashes; no benchmark replay.

gpu_comparison.scope: Numeric consistency of every indexed vector; not a substitute for the separate human-natural query/retrieval benchmark.
